messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The Customer Service Representative sends a Mortgage offer to the customer and waits for a reply. If the customer calls or writes back declining the mortgage, the case details are updated and the work is then archived prior to cancellation. If the customer sends back the completed offer documents and attaches all prerequisite documents then the case is moved to administration for completion. If all pre-requisite documents are not provided a message is generated to the customer requesting outstanding documents. If no answer is received after 2 weeks, the case details are updated prior to archive and cancellation.

    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForReply" name="Wait for Customer Reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Reply" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckReply" name="Check Reply Type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decline</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Accept</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- Decline Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_SendOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Event_WaitForReply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision" sourceRef="Event_WaitForReply" targetRef="Gateway_CheckReply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decline" name="Declined" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckReply" targetRef="Task_UpdateCaseDecline" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateCaseDecline" name="Update Case Details (Declined)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchiveDecline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveDecline" sourceRef="Task_UpdateCaseDecline" targetRef="Task_ArchiveDecline" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveDecline" name="Archive Work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchiveDecline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelDecline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelDecline" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveDecline" targetRef="EndEvent_Cancelled" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Cancelled" name="Case Cancelled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelDecline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CancelTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Accept Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept" name="Accepted / Documents Received" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckReply" targetRef="Gateway_CheckDocs" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckDocs" name="Check Prerequisite Docs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllDocsPresent</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocsMissing</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    
    <!-- All Docs Present -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllDocsPresent" name="All Docs Provided" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDocs" targetRef="Task_MoveToAdmin" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MoveToAdmin" name="Move to Administration for Completion">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllDocsPresent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Completed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completed" sourceRef="Task_MoveToAdmin" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Completion Handover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Completed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Missing Docs Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsMissing" name="Docs Not Provided" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckDocs" targetRef="Task_RequestDocs" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestDocs" name="Generate Message Requesting Outstanding Docs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DocsMissing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForDocs</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForDocs" sourceRef="Task_RequestDocs" targetRef="Event_WaitForDocs" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForDocs" name="Wait for Documents or Timeout">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForDocs</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DocsReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Timeout</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Docs" />
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_2Weeks">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT2W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    
    <!-- Loop back if docs received -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsReceived" name="Documents Received" sourceRef="Event_WaitForDocs" targetRef="Gateway_CheckDocs" />
    
    <!-- Timeout Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timeout" name="No Answer After 2 Weeks" sourceRef="Event_WaitForDocs" targetRef="Task_UpdateCaseTimeout" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateCaseTimeout" name="Update Case Details (Timeout)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Timeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArchiveTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveTimeout" sourceRef="Task_UpdateCaseTimeout" targetRef="Task_ArchiveTimeout" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveTimeout" name="Archive Work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArchiveTimeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CancelTimeout</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CancelTimeout" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveTimeout" targetRef="EndEvent_Cancelled" />
